name: ModifyRecord
caption: Modify Record

configuration.description: SmartField reference to the record, written as exactly one placeholder in double braces, e.g. "{{FindCustomers_results}}" or "{{trigger_Rec}}". It must resolve to a Reference (RecordId) in the flow context: an undotted name is looked up directly (an array reference such as {{FindX_results}} resolves to its first element, results[0]); a dotted path (e.g. {{trigger_Rec.Customer}}) is walked through the SmartField definitions. Surrounding whitespace is ignored. Bare names without braces are rejected.
Table number of the referenced record. The editor derives it from the reference; at runtime the resolved record's table must equal this number.
Run Triggers. true (default when absent) = BC standard OnModify(true): the table's OnModify trigger and its subscribers run; false = OnModify(false). Non-boolean values fall back to the default.
Field assignments applied (in ascending lineNo) to the fetched record before Modify. Only non-primary-key fields are allowed - use Rename Record to change key fields.

items.description: Row key and application order. Rows are applied in ascending lineNo. Must be unique within the array: rows are loaded into a keyed buffer, so two rows with the same lineNo (including two rows that omit it -> both 0) fail at runtime with a duplicate-record error. The editor writes 10000, 20000, ... in display order.
Field NUMBER (not name) of the target field in the configured table. Rows with fieldNo 0 are skipped. A number that does not exist in the table fails at runtime.

Value text. SmartFields ({{slug_output}}), SmartFormulas ([[...]]) and SmartControls are resolved first, then the text is converted to the field type (see inputFormat). Values longer than 2048 characters are supported (e.g. base64 for Blob/Media fields). With valueMode 'fixed' it holds an Option/Enum value NAME (e.g. 'Order'); an empty fixed value skips the row. With valueMode 'rules' it is ignored. For Option/Enum fields in SmartText mode the name, the caption in the session language or an ordinal number are accepted (exact name, exact caption, case-insensitive name/caption, then a number that is one of the field's ordinals; a number that is no ordinal is assigned as given).
true (default when the key is absent) = assign via Validate so the field's OnValidate trigger runs (as if typed on the page); false = assign directly without validation.

How the value text is parsed into the field type. Empty/absent = the session's regional format (locale-sensitive). "9" or "xml" (case-insensitive) = invariant XML notation (1000.00, 2026-07-16, true). Otherwise a date/time pattern built from the fixed-width tokens yyyy, yy, MM, dd, HH, mm, ss (each at most once) plus non-alphanumeric separators, e.g. yyyyMMdd, dd.MM.yyyy, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. Patterns need a complete date (yyyy|yy + MM + dd) or at least HH+mm; ss needs mm, mm needs HH. Patterns are only allowed for Date, Time and DateTime fields. Omitted by the editor when empty.

How 'value' is read. 'fixed' = value is an Option/Enum value name picked from the field's list (empty -> the row is skipped). 'rules' = the value comes from valueRules (first rule whose condition is true, else otherwise; nothing -> the row is skipped and the field keeps its current value). 'smarttext' or absent = the SmartText in 'value'. Compared case-insensitively; any other text counts as smarttext. The editor offers the modes only for Option and Enum fields and omits the key in SmartText mode; the runtime reads it on any row.

Only with valueMode 'rules': { "rules": [ { "condition": "<SmartFilter condition>", "value": "<value name>" }, ... ], "otherwise": "<value name>" }. Conditions use the SmartFilter grammar of the Decision step; {{...}} tokens in them are substituted before the step runs. Rules are tried in order; a rule with a blank condition or an empty value never matches. 'otherwise' may be omitted or empty (then a non-matching row is skipped). Also accepted as a JSON string holding that object. The editor writes it only in rules mode and drops blank rules.

true = skip the row (and write a Debug log line) when its value is empty, so the field keeps its current value instead of failing the conversion or being cleared. Empty means: the resolved text is '' (any field type); Date/Time/DateTime also 0D/0T/0DT and Guid the null GUID; Blob/Media a bare binary SmartField with an empty payload; RecordId no resolvable reference and empty text. An explicit 0 / false in a numeric, Boolean, Duration or Option field is a real value and is applied; a non-empty value that cannot be converted still fails. Absent, null or non-boolean -> false (the row is applied as before).

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be present and non-zero. The editor derives it from the reference; it is not a separate required field.
rules.message: Table No. is required for a Modify Record step.

rules.check: configuration.tableNo is read as an integer (missing, null, non-integer -> 0); 0 fails the step.
rules.message: Table No. is required for a Modify Record step.

rules.check: Write tableNo as a JSON number. A value that cannot be read as an integer counts as 0, and the step fails.
configuration.reference must be present and non-empty. The editor's Reference field is required.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: configuration.reference must be a single SmartField placeholder: after trimming it starts with '{{', ends with '}}' and has a non-empty name inside. Anything else cannot be resolved, and the step fails.
rules.message: Reference "%1" cannot be resolved to a record.

rules.check: The reference must resolve to an existing record reference in the flow context at run time.
rules.message: Reference "%1" cannot be resolved to a record.

rules.check: The table of the resolved record must equal configuration.tableNo.
rules.message: Reference resolves to table %1 but the step is configured for table %2.

rules.check: values must be a JSON array; any other type is ignored, so the record is saved unchanged.
triggers should be a JSON boolean; other types fall back to true.

values[].inputFormat must be empty, '9', 'xml' (case-insensitive) or a structurally valid date/time pattern (tokens yyyy|yy, MM, dd, HH, mm, ss each at most once; only non-alphanumeric separators; date tokens all-or-nothing; ss requires mm, mm requires HH; at least a full date or HH+mm). Checked when the row is converted (rows for Blob, Media and RecordId fields and rows with fieldNo 0 are not converted, so their inputFormat is not checked). The step fails on the first invalid row.
rules.message: "%1" is not a valid input format. Leave it empty for the regional format, enter 9 or xml for the invariant XML notation, or enter a date/time pattern such as yyyyMMdd (tokens yyyy, yy, MM, dd, HH, mm, ss plus separators).

rules.check: A date/time pattern inputFormat was used on a field that is not Date, Time or DateTime.
rules.message: Input format "%1" is a date/time pattern and can only be used for Date, Time, or DateTime fields. Field "%2" is of type %3.

rules.check: The resolved value text cannot be converted to the field type (Integer, BigInteger, Decimal, Boolean, Date, Time, DateTime, Duration, Option, Guid, RecordId). Without inputFormat the first message is used, with an inputFormat the second.
rules.message: Cannot convert value "%1" to %2 for field "%3". | Cannot convert value "%1" to %2 for field "%3" using input format "%4".

rules.check: An Option/Enum field's resolved value (fixed name, rules result or SmartText) must be one of the field's value names or captions (case-insensitive fallback) or a number. Checked when the row is converted.
rules.message: Cannot convert value "%1" to %2 for field "%3". Allowed: %4.

rules.check: Status line of the config canvas: every rule in a values[] row with valueMode 'rules' needs a non-blank condition and a non-empty value. Advisory only (does not block saving); at runtime such a rule never matches.
rules.message: %1, row %2: %3 (e.g. Field Values, row 2: Rule 1 needs a condition and a value.)

rules.check: A values[] row with optional = true whose value is empty is skipped; one Debug log line per skipped row. Modify(triggers) still runs.
rules.message: Field "%1" skipped: it is optional and its value is empty.

rules.check: values[].lineNo must be unique; duplicates (or several rows without lineNo) raise the platform's 'record already exists' error when the rows are loaded.
Every non-zero values[].fieldNo must exist in the target table.
rules.message: Field %1 does not exist in table %2.

rules.check: values[] must not contain primary-key fields (the editor only offers non-key fields).
rules.message: Field "%1" is part of the primary key and cannot be modified. Use a Rename Record step instead.

notes: The record is re-read from the database (Get) before the values are applied, so changes made by earlier steps are visible.
Output 'rec' points at the same record as the input reference; it is mainly useful to pass a typed reference on.
An empty values array is allowed: the record is then modified unchanged (Modify(triggers) still runs).
Primary-key fields in values[] fail the step at runtime; the editor's field lookup hides them.
See Insert Record for value conversion details (inputFormat, Option names, Blob/Media, RecordId fields) and for the valueMode / valueRules / optional row keys.

Rows that yield no value leave the field as it is: valueMode 'fixed' with an empty value, valueMode 'rules' where no rule matches and 'otherwise' is empty or absent, and optional = true with an empty value (the last one logs a Debug line).

Before 27.0.41: valueMode, valueRules and optional did not exist (a hand-written valueMode was ignored and the row read as SmartText; an empty value was always assigned, clearing text fields and failing on typed fields). Option names/captions were matched case-sensitively and mapped by list position.
Writing step: a Confirm dialog placed after this step (in document order) produces a publish warning, because Business Central cannot open a dialog once the flow has written to the database.
